question: At the actual recognition clock, how much of the dipole lifecycle remains?

applicability_conditions: All four dates, all live archived candidates
unresolved_aspects: Whether a different endpoint (price-based) would give a different share
endpoint: n/a (negative lead: recognition is 0 to 575 s after the endpoint for the ended half)
measured_lead_time: endpoint is a convention; finalization-only candidates (1 on Oct 3, 1 on Oct 17) excluded from live counts

measured_lead_time: flow_state is a Codex-recorded label at emission

question: When a displayed touch becomes one lot, does the level hold or break?
interpretation: Breaking (retreat) depends on how the level became thin and on fresh flow: a standing best that shrank to one lot while fresh flow attacks it retreats about two thirds of the time; a new best quote of one lot with flow going the other way holds about two thirds of the time.

question: Do the dipole layers together supply most of the knowledge needed for the decisions?
interpretation: Rerun v2: at the Native recognition clock the dipole carries no direction or magnitude; at the earliest knowable clock (window saturation, +5 s) the window ALONE still carries no realizable direction (ride to the END of the exhaustion second 192/369/180, 213/431/180, 192/345/203, 227/379/246; after exhaustion and after flip +60 s symmetric). The first pass's 3:1 drive was the midpoint before the opposed print (CONFLICTS C16). What the dipole supplies is the clocks: saturation at +1 s, exhaustion onset at p50 19-20 s, flip at 34-36 s (preceding the FLIP successor's birth by p50 23-39 s), all 15-30 s before Native recognition. Direction at that clock comes from the touch queue on both sides (own/target touch ratio and own-side order count, from Ccode's life paths and from the raw tape independently), modestly and on all four dates (exit-rule up/down high 80/39, 65/32, 78/40, 84/55 vs low 35/61, 49/61, 50/71, 52/87). So the dipole layers together do NOT supply most of the needed knowledge; they supply recognition timing, the exhaustion mark and the transition warning, and the book supplies direction.
contrary_or_absent_correspondence: At the recognition clock all of this is already spent; from k=+5 the fixed 60/300 s horizons are symmetric (the drive is given back) unless the exhaustion exit is used
unresolved_aspects: A sub-recognition detector (onset-based, M6-1) was not tested against price outcomes
source_references: all of the above; REPORT.md sections 5, 6, 13; tables/m16b_exhaustion_convention_check.json; tables/m26_v2_headline_cells.json; tables/m24_flip_successor_and_peaks.json
